architectureDecisions: D1 — Grok cost guard in parseGrokJson: read value.total_cost_usd raw and report it only when typeof raw === "number" && Number.isFinite(raw) && raw >= 0, else null. Delete the Number(value.total_cost_usd) coercion so null/""/true/"0.5" can never become 0/0/1/0.5. Update the function comment to observed-only cost.

D2 — Numeric zero stays an observed 0; NaN, Infinity and negative numbers are not observed costs and report null. Token parsing (integer usage tokens, null with GROK_USAGE_NOT_REPORTED/GROK_JSON_TRUNCATED) is unchanged.

D3 — projectAgentTaskContext writes a worktree-local .exharness/.gitignore containing "*\n" instead of resolving git rev-parse --git-path info/exclude and appending .exharness/. No git metadata path is opened for writing; readFile/appendFile against info/exclude are removed.

D4 — Candidate-commit exclusion is preserved worktree-locally: the .gitignore keeps git status clean for .exharness/context copies and the copies never enter the candidate commit. The grounded prompt prefix and fail-closed AgentTaskContextError behavior are unchanged.

D5 — Tests FU1 call parseGrokJson directly over a usage-bearing cost matrix (null, "", true, "0.5", NaN, -1, 0, 0.5); tests FU2 call projectAgentTaskContext directly on a scratch source repo plus a linked worktree from the delivered createLocalGitWorkspace, asserting byte-identical source info/exclude and candidate-commit exclusion. Hermetic os.tmpdir scratch; no network, no credentials, no real agent CLIs.

D6 — Living docs/living/system/agent-tools/observation.md grok row: totalCostUsd is observed only for a finite total_cost_usd number >= 0, else null, never zero-filled. Living docs/living/system/agent-tools/context.md: exclusion is worktree-local (.exharness/.gitignore) and the source repository is never written. No Blackboard ids.

D7 — Evidence: executed followup-probe-result.json (DELIVERED_TRUTH: grokNullCost 0, grokEmptyStringCost 0, grokTrueCost 1, grokNumericStringCost 0.5, excludeResolvedInsideWorktree false, sourceExcludeChanged true).
D8 — auditPaths against this plan rejects packages/agentic-system/** and docs/blackboard/**.

S2 — Worktree-local exclusion [FU2]: implement D3–D4 gitignore projection. Tests assert byte-identical source info/exclude and candidate-commit exclusion through projectAgentTaskContext.
S3 — Docs and scope [FU3]: Living observed-cost and exclusion sentences; auditPaths rejects agentic-system.
